annotations.title: Draft a pitch to a brand

description: Records a pitch to a brand that fits and returns it to put in a Gmail draft: the creator's real numbers and rates, a link to their Work with me page that tells them when the brand opens it, and an opt-out line with their mailing address. The same checks as pitch_check run first and refuse with the reasons. angle is one sentence, in the creator's voice, on why this brand: something true from their posts or the brand's own products. Put the subject and body in a Gmail draft to the address in to and leave it for the creator to read and send; never send it, and never add claims, numbers or prices of your own. Adds the brand and the person to the contact book and a deal at stage inquiry (source outbound) with a follow-up in 7 days. Counts toward the plan's open deals (PLAN_LIMIT when full).

angle.description: One sentence on why this brand, like 'I've used your sunscreen in my last three beach videos.'

category.description: What they sell, like 'skincare', checked against what the creator declines and their exclusivities

contact_email.description: A person already in the contact book, or an address the brand publishes on its own site

found_at.description: The https page on the brand's site that shows the address (its contact, press or partnerships page)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

partner_id.description: The brand in the contact book (partners_list), when it's there

website.description: The brand's own website; the address has to be at its domain

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
